question: Which goddess forms are traditionally included among the eight remembered forms?
premises: Kāmeśvarī and Bhadrakālī are named among the forms.
Tāriṇī is remembered as part of a set of eight.
inference: The tradition remembers a set of eight goddess forms including Kāmeśvarī, Bhadrakālī, and Tāriṇī.
uncertainties: Only some members of the eightfold set are explicitly named in this verse.
plain_english: Kāmeśvarī, Bhadrakālī, and Tāriṇī are remembered among the eight forms.
